title: Jahmyr Gibbs: My agent can handle my contract, I'm just thinking about the team and ball

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jahmyr Gibbs: My agent can handle my contract, I'm just thinking about the team and ball
sources.description: Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs is heading into the fourth season of his rookie contract, which means he's eligible to get a new deal, and surely wants to become one of the highest-paid running backs in football.
